text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Something deep in my chest is boiling 
hot...!? Amazing... I feel like I could 
run forever...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Could it be, the Three Goddesses are 
calling me...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if they've been watching over 
the Umamusume like this the entire 
time..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Fufu. Then I must cherish this 
power.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I will reach it, without fail— to that 
breathtaking view no one has ever seen!
